name: Coral Coast
tagline: Dunes, white beaches, shark dives and river gorges on Viti Levu's south coast
description: The Coral Coast is the stretch of Viti Levu's south coast between Sigatoka and Suva, a popular backpacking route. Sigatoka Sand Dunes, Fiji's first national park, rise 20 to 60 m at the river mouth, and Natadola Beach is a white-sand beach west of Sigatoka with horse riding. Pacific Harbour is the base for shark dives in Beqa Lagoon, and Beqa Island lies 10 km offshore. Inland, the Upper Navua Gorge offers whitewater rafting, and Tavuni Hill Fort is a semi-restored hill fort built by a Tongan chief.
whyVisit: Dive with sharks in Beqa Lagoon

goodToKnow.title: Pay at Biausevu village
goodToKnow.detail: Biausevu Waterfalls are about a 30-minute walk from the village, with nine stream crossings. The entry and guide fee is paid in the village first.

goodToKnow.title: Base at Pacific Harbour
goodToKnow.detail: Beqa Lagoon shark dives leave from Pacific Harbour, so stay there if the dive is your reason for coming.

goodToKnow.title: Rafting takes a full day
goodToKnow.detail: The Upper Navua Gorge is run on Class II-III rafting day trips of about eight hours, so keep the whole day free.

bestTimeBlurb: Come in {months}, Fiji's cooler months, for beach days and reef dives. Cyclones can occur Nov to Apr.
